title: 第19章  铁布衫小火第20章  武道圣胎
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
“如果我没记错的话，你就是这铁布衫的开创者，苏青？”
江夏守备局，猛兽小队队长，刘有财问他道。
“是我没错，但谁开创的无需在意，重要的是这门武学，真的对各位有用啊！”
苏青王婆卖瓜，卖力推销。
可惜收效甚微，原本听他说起铁布衫，还有点兴趣的人。
一看他岁数长相，以及胸前挂着的那可怜的一颗武星，顿时没了兴趣。
这让苏青懊恼不已，心道王天宏刷星星的行为虽然可耻，但真的有用啊。
一胸口的资历摆出来，就很有说服力了。
哪至于跟现在一样，被人质疑小觑。
无奈，他只要拉过杨铁牛，让他现场演示。
“胸口碎大石！”
“飞刀刮肚皮！”
“肉身扛子弹，这个还差点意思，但等我铁牛兄弟将铁布衫修行圆满，也不是不能！”
一套肉身横练效果演示下来。
见周围聚来的人越来越多。
苏青这才让铁牛展示重头戏。
只见他屏息凝神，心游神外，倏忽间，其人好像化成了一块万年不变的顽铁。
那猛兽岭里无所不在的妖雾，遇到他时自动退散，完全无法污染他精神体躯。
这一幕，让董宇等守备队员在内的所有人，都眼前一亮。
像他们这些人，也不是不想淬炼武道意志。

但此类武学，只有D级以上，能触摸到精神领域的武者，才能修行。
他们这些人就算想学也是学不了的。
而现在，杨铁牛这个跟他们一样的F级武者，分明跟他们展示了精神层次的力量。
虽然不是那等扭曲现实，形成幻象的强悍法门。
只是能抵御亚空间精神污染而已。
但这对他们而言，就完全够用了！
“这是精神意志类武学？”董宇激动道。
“不是，本质上还是横练硬功，但锤炼肉身时，淬炼意志，也能潜移默化的提升武道意志，增强精神能量。”
苏青实话实说道，他是想推销铁布衫没错，但也没想过夸大其词。
有什么说什么。
铁布衫这淬炼武道意志的能力，对于联邦底层武者的重要性，他也是来到这猛兽岭后，才突然意识到的。
content_en:
"If I remember correctly, you are the founder of this iron shirt, Su Qing?"
Liu Youcai, captain of the Jiangxia Defense Bureau and the Beast Squadron, asked him.
"It's me, but it doesn't matter who created it. What's important is that this martial arts is really useful to you!"
Su Qing Wangpo sells melons and sells them hard.
Unfortunately, it had little effect. Originally, some people were a little interested when they heard him talk about Iron Cloth Shirt.
After seeing his age, appearance, and the pitiful martial arts star hanging on his chest, I immediately lost interest.
This made Su Qing very upset, thinking that although Wang Tianhong's behavior of brushing stars was shameful, it was really useful.
Once you put all your qualifications on display, it's very convincing.
How could it be the same as now, being questioned and looked down upon.
He had no choice but to pull Yang Tieniu over and let him demonstrate on the spot.
"The chest is broken with rocks!"
"Scrape your belly with a flying knife!"
"Carrying bullets with your own body is a bit uninteresting, but it's not impossible for my brother Tieniu to complete his training in Iron Cloth Shirt!"
The effect of a set of physical horizontal training is demonstrated.
I saw more and more people gathering around.
Only then did Su Qing let Tieniu show off the highlight.
I saw him holding his breath and concentrating, his mind wandering. Suddenly, he seemed to have turned into a piece of iron that would remain unchanged for thousands of years.
The omnipresent demonic mist in the Beast Ridge automatically dispersed when it encountered him, completely unable to pollute his mental body.
This scene made everyone, including Dong Yu and other defensive members, shine.
It’s not that people like them don’t want to temper their martial will.
However, this type of martial arts can only be practiced by warriors of level D or above who can touch the spiritual realm.
People like them can't learn even if they want to.
But now, Yang Tieniu, an F-level warrior like them, clearly showed them the power of the spiritual level.
Although it is not a powerful method that distorts reality and creates illusions.
It can only resist the mental pollution of subspace.
But this is enough for them!
"Is this spiritual martial arts?" Dong Yu said excitedly.
"No, in essence, it is still hard training, but when tempering the body and tempering the will, it can also subtly improve the martial arts will and enhance the spiritual energy."
Su Qing told the truth, it was true that he wanted to promote Iron Clothes, but he did not want to exaggerate.
Say whatever you have to say.
He only suddenly realized the importance of Tiebushan's ability to temper his martial will to the low-level warriors of the Federation after he came to the Beast Ridge.
